verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is a USB/NFC hardware security key for passkeys/WebAuthn, OATH, PIV and OpenPGP. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in servers and calls their tools is a category error for this kind of device, and nothing in the evidence suggests it ships such a capability. The Shopify-generated llms.txt on the store is a shopping-agent file and is not about MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
